$comment: sci-audit bundled scientific-core connectors. REMOTE (HTTP) ONLY — no stdio/local binaries by design (claude.ai-web compatible). Only servers with an official/community REMOTE endpoint are embedded here; anything without one (e.g. crossref) is connected as a claude.ai connector instead — see README 'MCP & connectors'. All embedded servers below are keyless (public bibliographic data); a keyed server uses ${ENV_VAR} expansion, never plaintext. PLACEHOLDER (future): a self-hosted tr-sciaudit-mcp (FastMCP) would be added here as an env-gated remote entry, e.g. {"type":"http","url":"https://tr-sciaudit.<host>/mcp","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer ${TR_SCIAUDIT_MCP_API_KEY}"}} — see README.
